explanation: How saving works under each design. The left is the current plan, where every save shares one branch; the right gives each save its own pull request. Keys aren't affected either way.

columns.title: One shared pull request (now)
items: Save adds to the waiting pull request if there is one
The screen shows the waiting changes
Needs locking, ownership checks and leftover-branch handling
Review keeps finding new gaps here

columns.title: A pull request per save (simpler)
items: Each Save opens a new pull request on a new branch
The screen shows main, plus a list of pull requests waiting to merge
Nothing shared, so nothing to overwrite
Two waiting saves can conflict; GitHub shows it and you close one
